title: [finding] The four #2762 P1/P2 Approval Center behaviours shipped in #2803/#2811 are unpinned — a scope probe written against origin/main passes, and nothing else asserts them
body:
Recorded while re-verifying objectstack-ai/objectui#2762's remaining scope. **Not a live defect** — the behaviours below all work on `origin/main` today. The observation is that three of the four have **no test at all**, so nothing would notice if they were dropped.

## What is unpinned

`apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` carries three delivered behaviours with no corresponding assertion anywhere in `apps/console` or `packages/app-shell`:

1. **Approver chips carry their 会签 group** — `approverChips()` keys by (name, group) so two different approvers with the same display name stay two labelled chips (`Dev Admin · Finance` / `Dev Admin · Legal`). Delivered by #2811. Nothing asserts the group ever reaches the DOM; the whole point of the fix is that two chips are distinguishable, and a regression that dropped the group span would collapse them back to the reported symptom silently.
2. **A flow-initiated request names its origin** — `isSystemSubmitter()` plus the "Flow-initiated" cell, instead of the reported bare person icon + em dash. Delivered by #2803.
3. **Record-card copy and emphasis** — `prettifyKey()` drops a trailing `id` token so `owner_id` reads "Owner"; `decisionAmountEntry()` promotes the decision amount to a lead figure and excludes it from the generic field grid so it renders once. Delivered by #2803.

The fourth item (declared action hierarchy: `variant: 'primary'` renders filled, `variant: 'danger'` renders destructive) **is** pinned, at `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.test.tsx` — "maps the spec action `variant` onto Button variants".

The existing `ApprovalsInboxPage.*.test.tsx` files cover different things: cell identity across a clock tick, hidden-field trim, raw-payload gating, record links, and the vertical step strip.

## How this was measured

A four-case probe was written against unmodified `origin/main` at `591bf2791` and run from the repo root. All four cases passed, which is what makes this a finding rather than a defect card. Its fixture is the non-degenerate one the class needs: **two different approver ids sharing one display name and filling two different groups** (`u_fin` in Finance, `u_leg` in Legal), a `flow:` submitter id, and a payload carrying both `owner_id` and `amount`. A single-approver or single-group fixture passes against the pre-fix code and proves nothing.

Reading, verbatim:

```
Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  4 passed (4)
```

The probe was not committed — as assertions that pass on `origin/main` they are characterization tests, not a fix, and they belong to whichever card decides to keep them.

## Why this may still be worth doing before the rebuild

objectstack-ai/objectui#2763 rebuilds this surface on the standard SDUI renderer, so tests written against today's hand-written DOM would be rewritten with it. The counter-argument is that these four behaviours are exactly the ones the rebuild must preserve, and right now there is no written record of them beyond source comments. Triage's call, not this seat's.

Related: objectstack-ai/objectui#2762, objectstack-ai/objectui#2763. Delivering commits: `1a03af69e` (#2803), `7cb199b1c` (#2811).
